summary: This bill establishes a grant program through the Environmental Protection Agency to fund projects and studies aimed at reducing food waste by 50 percent by 2035, relative to 2015 levels.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to reduce food waste by 50% by 2035 through grants for prevention, rescue, upcycling, and recycling. Reducing food waste can significantly decrease methane emissions from landfills and conserve resources, directly contributing to environmental protection.
